name: Prime Window
intent: Apply primer to bare wood windows or any metal windows. Skipped for factory-primed wood. Brush or spray gated by application method. Per-window rate.
doctrine: Spray prime (15 win/hr) is 2.5x faster than brush (6 win/hr). Both gate by substrate_state=SS_BARE — factory-primed windows skip this entire module via task gating. Note: this module's task gates are simpler than the source spec's (which also gates by metal substrate). For metal windows the prep module already handles the etch/rust steps; the prime task here will fire for bare metal at the same rate as bare wood.
